title: Engie $400 Credit for Gas and Electricty ($200 Per Fuel) on First Bill + Free 1 Year NRMA Membership
body:
Deal: Engie $400 Credit for Gas and Electricty ($200 Per Fuel) on First Bill + Free 1 Year NRMA Membership

[faisan] Are there any waiting periods if you used them recently and got the $200 credit?
[Mortin] Can gat it on partners name?
If I have claimed it this year already?
[djsydney] Even if its the same address? Just under partners name can work?
[Mortin] Do youbhave to do a disconnection or something?
[swiggity123] @Mortin: Technically yes - it is dosconnected and reconnected into the new persons name. However if you have a smart meter there is usually no interruption at all. This is because a non-smart meter someone has to do the final reading but if you have a smart meter the usage details are automatically transferred.
[tenpercent] I haven't used Engie before. If the electricity provider bills quarterly, but I use up my credit in the first month, can i churn away and pay almost $0 or will churning away before the first bill is issued void the $200 credit?
[golfer152] Stack with TCB to get $150/$120 or $370 for both Electricity and Gas.
[tenpercent] Thanks :)
Can I stack the Engie referral too?
[romaau] I am only been offered $150 with Engie using TCB
Actually only $150 on Engie website as well.
Maybe because they don't offer Gas in SE QLD?
[tenpercent] Did it expire? I can only see econex with $150 /$120.
Edit: Shopback has $130/$120.
[lothus777] Good support. I transferred my remaining gas credits to electricity before leaving
[Lord Ra] I'm at the bare minimum daily supply charge with OVO with the 3 hours free. I don't think this is worth the hassle for me.
Too much admin work for $200 pure electric household.
[hj0809] It seems to stack with the referral code. On the last sign up page it says both $75 credit and $400 so don't think there's any ambiguity (though screencapped).
[Megatron] They have the worst rates in SA, specially for gas.. their usage charges are about 50% higher that other retailers even after the discount.. esnure to compare rates before switching as the $200 may not be worth the trouble.
[PeterA07] Watch out for the rates, even if you're intending to churn later. I signed up on a bill credit deal a few months ago, and my rates were jacked up massively two weeks after sign-up. I checked online not long after and the rates were about 10 per cent higher than what was available for new sign-ups (inclusive of NRMA membership). Had to call and get them to switch me to a new plan.
[brb223] I agree, people often just pay their bills, and the companie use the "new plans" tactic. They increased mine every second or third month.
[puzzles2] For some reason I always get denied for my application with Engie even though I don't have any other issues for mobile/utility plans or credit cards.
[dealsgrabber] I have the exact same issue. Tired about 3-4 times in the past year and always getting denied due to not meeting credit checks. I have never defaulted or made any late payments in the last 12 years for utilities, cards etc. Seems their credit check criteria is screwed up for some reason.
[DealHuntersXD] Does it impact the credit score? As I will just keep it for a month or 2 before churning again. So 2 switches in <3 months
[justanick] What’s the difference between this and Econnex deal posted few days ago? You get $100 gas credit card too
[DaddyChill] With Econnex, in the past I've combined $200 engie credit as well as $150 something credit card for electricity from them. Not sure if they still have the same thing available for gas right now.
[shermozle] Beware NRMA. You can't cancel online. The only way is to call. After two 40 minute calls that dropped out without being answered, I found their legal email address and told them they needed to cancel or they could expect a chargeback. 4 weeks later they responded with an "okay".
[Scythic] I managed to cancel NRMA through two emails with minimal effort.
[ozbmm] I didn’t pay any renewal fees and they canned it automatically after a couple of months.
[ozbmm] Showing $125 sign up bonus for me. Not $200
[USER DC] Offer is not available to all states.
Need to stay with them for 90days to get this credit(s).
nightmare company to deal with to get your credits
dealing with them using ombudsman currently, have never had a worse company before who did not want to settle out matters before unlike this one who want to drag matters each time
and makes your credit be worth $0 after account closing. (aka you cannot even come back to your account and use remaining credits you didnt use).
